name: std::basic_streambuf<CharT,Traits>::sgetc
intro:
Reads one character from the input sequence.

If the input sequence read position is not available, returns underflow(). Otherwise returns Traits::to_int_type(*gptr()).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The value of the character pointed to by the get pointer.

examples.output:
sgetc() returned 'H'
peek() returned 'H'
get() returned 'H'

summary: Reads one character from the input sequence.
